paths.description: Transformation from being consumed by anxious thoughts and mental chaos to achieving inner calm and peaceful awareness through meditation practice
paths.reasoning: This maps clearly to Path 12 (mirror + stillness → presence). The user describes moving from a state of self-reflection/awareness (mirror) through meditation/stillness practice to achieve presence. They explicitly mention 'being present and centered' and describe the T2 integration: recognizing alignment between their inner calm state and outer reality, creating wholeness ('From fragmented and anxious to integrated and peaceful'). The somatic domain matches perfectly - this transformation happened through embodied practice (meditation, nervous system relaxation) rather than just cognitive insight.
